registers.label: Spare
lines: Give thanks to the Lord, who is good.
God's steadfast love endures forever.
You taught us to walk, and lifted us like a child to your cheek.
We were held, and we did not know it.
A man filled his barns and called his soul safe — but the barns could not keep him.
Make us rich toward God, not toward ourselves.
Come, you whom the Lord has gathered, and worship.
We give thanks, for God is good. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Remember a parent crouched a few steps away, arms open, coaxing a wobbling toddler forward — that is how God taught Israel to walk.
God's steadfast love endures forever.
Bent down to feed them, lifted them to the cheek, led them with cords of kindness — and they did not know who was holding them.
God's steadfast love endures forever.
Meanwhile a rich man tore down his barns to build bigger ones, sure he had years of ease stored up — and that very night his life was asked of him.
God's steadfast love endures forever.
So set down the hoarding and the worry, and let yourself be gathered and fed by the One whose arms have held you all along.
God's steadfast love endures forever. Thanks be to God!
